extras.textures: PBR 2048px: base color, roughness, metallic, normal (baked)
extras.real_size: small one-ring circus big top, approx. 10.1 m wide, 10.5 m deep incl. entrance, 7 m tall
extras.notes: front faces -Y; round big top with 24 cream and red roof panels (bell-shaped roof with slight sag between seams), scalloped valance, warm light bulbs along the eave and on eight roof seams ('circus-tent_bulbs', emissive, not baked), gold mast tip with ball and star; cream and blue striped side wall with red skirt, 12 guy ropes to wooden stakes; entrance porch with striped gable roof, star on the gable and a dark arched doorway. Movable: 'circus-tent_flap_l' and 'circus-tent_flap_r' entrance flaps (shown tied open), origin at the front porch pole, rotate about Z (-90 deg left flap, +90 deg right flap closes them). No text

origin.detail: Built procedurally with Blender scripts. The scripts were written with the help of an AI coding assistant. No generative AI model produced the geometry or textures directly.
